subject: Post-demo recap: decision roles, contract routing & immediate NDA

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: decision roles, contract routing & immediate NDA

Hi Ava / Michael — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick written recap and asks so we can keep momentum: 

Key decision roles we heard on the call (please correct):
- Economic buyer: Ava Lewis (confirm)
- Security owner: Priya Rao (I believe she’s the technical reviewer)
- Procurement / contracts: Michael Chen

Decision criteria you mentioned: latency at scale, on-prem private deployment option, predictable per-token economics, and audit log retention for HIPAA compliance.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) NDA first: we can send our standard mutual NDA and get that executed in parallel with technical follow-up.
2) Routing plan for contracting: proposed sequence NDA -> DPA -> MSA (redline on MSA after DPA details agreed).
3) Requested turn-times: we typically see 48–72 hours per internal review/redline; please confirm if procurement needs longer.
4) Please confirm owners/emails for procurement and security so we route docs to the right inboxes.

I’ve attached our NDA template and a sample MSA redline so you can see the structure. I’ll loop Ben (legal lead for pre-signing) to propose an internal routing cadence.

If this looks right I’ll send the NDA via DocuSign today and open a HubSpot deal record for tracking.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: decision roles, contract routing & immediate NDA

Thanks Tessa — great session. Confirming: I am the economic buyer and will approve budget if the security and procurement lanes are satisfied.

Owners:
- Security technical reviewer: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novumhealth.com> (copied)
- Procurement / contracting: Michael Chen <michael.chen@novumhealth.com> (copied)

Timeline guidance: procurement typically needs 10 business days from receipt of a clean NDA to get SOW/MSA routing started; security may need 1–2 weeks for a standard SOC/architecture review. If you can share the NDA today that accelerates things.

Decision criteria prioritization (helpful for scoring):
1) Data residency & encryption at rest/in transit
2) Audit logs & retention policy (HIPAA controls)
3) SLA on latency for 99th percentile requests
4) Cost per 1k tokens + predictable burst pricing

We prefer the NDA first; please route it to Michael for procurement to countersign, and to Priya for security awareness.

Best,
Ava

--
Ava Lewis
Head of Digital Transformation | Novum Health
ava.lewis@novumhealth.com | +1 212-555-0102
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: decision roles, contract routing & immediate NDA

Looping in internal contract process / recommended routing based on stated priorities.

Suggested routing & block times (internal default):
- Step 1 (Day 0): Send mutual NDA to all external owners — request signature via DocuSign (target: 3 business days).
- Step 2 (Day 1–5): Security intake: Priya to complete architecture checklist + any data flow diagrams (target: 5–10 business days depending on SOC artifacts).
- Step 3 (Day 5–12): DPA review (if needed) to capture retention and breach notification windows (we can parallelize with security).
- Step 4 (Day 8–18): MSA redline sprint — we’ll accept a single consolidated redline; our legal commitment is 48 hours turnaround for first-pass redline, then 24–48 hours for follow-ups provided changes are consolidated.

I’ll own the initial NDA redline and the MSA first-pass on Redwood’s side. To speed the loop, please add procurement contact(s) on DocuSign envelope and attach any internal redlines you prefer. I’ve attached our standard NDA and the example MSA redline we referenced on the call.

Questions for Tessa / Novum:
- Do you have a preferred DocuSign process (single-sign or parallel signing)?
- If procurement requires PO/finance gating, when should we estimate the PO issuance in your internal timeline?

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
